sections.what_happened: Two men (24yo British national; 25yo dual British-Iranian) re-arrested under National Security Act s3 on suspicion of assisting Iran's intelligence service over the Sept 27 RAF Fairford incident (three suspicious vans, petrol found, no IEDs; homes evacuated); 7 arrested total, 5 on bail; PM Andy Burnham: plot 'almost certainly directed by IRGC'; Iran denies
sections.what_verified: CNN + BBC-Persian graphic + multiple relays of the same Counter Terrorism Policing statement
sections.what_disputed: Iran denies involvement; no charges filed yet; no IEDs found; Iran notes it regards bases used to attack it as 'legitimate targets' (statement of position, not admission)
sections.why_matters: Britain says Iran tried to hit the American bombers parked in England — two men re-arrested, seven in the net. Fairford is where the B-1s bombing Iran flew from. Map card: Fairford + Sept 27 timeline
sections.context: Background: UK — two re-arrested in RAF Fairford Iran-linked plot probe
